tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind the conversation column.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The cluster panel, the composer, the step-detail sheet, scenario cards.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Step cards, tags, code wells, pod cards inside the panel.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Hover and selected fills; progress and meter tracks.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: the panel's left edge, section dividers, tab rule. Decoration only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that mark a control (composer, select, miss tag, switch track) on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-2`: at least 3:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-2` and `surface-3` (at least 12:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, captions, placeholders, inactive tabs on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-2` and `surface-3` (at least 4.6:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Teal. Primary buttons, the active tab rule, the running step's border, the remaining-work line, the avatar. Text on it is `on-accent`.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and pressed.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent` and `accent-hover` (7.3:1 dark, 5.1:1 light). Dark text in the dark theme because the teal is lightened there.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Citation chips, the cache-hit tag, the selected step card, the remaining-work area fill.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `accent-soft` (7.5:1 dark, 6.4:1 light), and teal text links on `bg` and `surface`.

tokens.name: ready
tokens.usage: Dot for a Ready pod. Always next to the word Ready.

tokens.name: ready-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the Ready status chip.

tokens.name: ready-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `ready-soft` (9.4:1 dark, 5.7:1 light).

tokens.name: starting
tokens.usage: Dot for a pod that is starting or warming up (cold start, warm-up routing). Blue, so it is never confused with Ready by hue alone.

tokens.name: starting-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the Starting status chip and of the cold-start progress track.

tokens.name: starting-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `starting-soft` (9.8:1 dark, 6.1:1 light).

tokens.name: draining
tokens.usage: Dot for a draining pod (scale-down: no new runs, current runs finish).

tokens.name: draining-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the Draining status chip and of overload notices.

tokens.name: draining-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `draining-soft` (10.5:1 dark, 6.4:1 light).

tokens.name: failed
tokens.usage: Dot for a killed or failed pod; text and border of the Kill pod button on `surface` (6.9:1 dark, 5.2:1 light).

tokens.name: failed-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the Failed status chip and of the pod-lost notice.

tokens.name: failed-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `failed-soft` (9.3:1 dark, 7.4:1 light).

tokens.name: avatar
tokens.usage: Fill of the pixel horse. Its eye is a hole, so the ground shows through.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring, 2px offset. At least 4.6:1 on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-2` in both themes.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind the step-detail sheet, over the conversation column only; the cluster panel stays visible.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: What should the agent work on?
styles.usage: The New task heading. Once per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: Compare the termination clauses in contract A and contract B.
styles.usage: The task, as the heading of a run.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings in the conversation and the sheet; scenario card titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Contract B is riskier. Its supplier can terminate with 30 days' notice and no cure period.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: The run continues on vllm-1 from its saved history.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, status chips, pod names in headings.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Secondary metadata under a metric or a row.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Panel section labels, set in capitals.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Tool calls, results, header names and values, run ids.

styles.name: data-sm
styles.usage: Tags on step cards; pod and run ids in compact rows.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: The one big number in a panel section: remaining work, replicas.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Dot to label; tag inner gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between tags; between step cards in the grid.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding; row gaps inside the panel.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel section padding; composer padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between panel sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between blocks of a run (header, steps, answer).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Conversation column top padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Conversation column side padding at full width.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Step numbers, citation chips, meter fills.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, status chips, small buttons, selects.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Step cards, pod cards, scenario cards, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The composer and the step-detail sheet.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Switches and status dots.

tokens.name: shadow-raise
tokens.usage: The composer and scenario cards. Everything else is flat and separated by `line`.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: The step-detail sheet and menus only.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: The top bar across both columns.

tokens.name: panel-width
tokens.usage: The cluster panel on the right of the split view; it never collapses during a demo.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the conversation column's content.

tokens.name: sheet-width
tokens.usage: The step-detail sheet, opened over the right edge of the conversation column.

tokens.name: horse-1x
tokens.usage: Horse at one screen pixel per art pixel: favicon, inline in dense rows.

tokens.name: horse-2x
tokens.usage: Top bar, beside the Answer heading, the run progress line.

tokens.name: horse-4x
tokens.usage: The New task screen.

tokens.name: horse-8x
tokens.usage: Showcase only. Always a whole multiple of 14px so the pixels stay square.
